# AI Agent Intro

This fixture is intentionally small and local so the golden demo can run without
network access or API keys.

Facts to preserve:

- AI agents combine language-model reasoning with tool use.
- Reliable agent workflows need explicit checkpoints before expensive actions.
- Artifact gates make agent progress inspectable and debuggable.
- A video-maker agent should separate source intake, script review, scene build,
  render packaging, and publish-readiness review.
